title: Comparison of the Needle Tip Location by the Position of the Operator During Ultrasound Guided LIJV Catheterization.
brief_summary: When the left internal jugular vein catheterization under short-axis ultrasound guided, an operator should be stand around the lying patient's head. The investigators are going to evaluate to effects of the operator's location.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Central venous catheterization required on lt. IJV

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of cervical spine surgery
* Abnormal structure of cervical spine, carotid artery or jugular vein
* Disease of carotid artery
* Immobilization due to cervical spine fracture or other diseases.
